channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Montrezl Harrell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Montrezl Harrell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nic Claxton on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Nic Claxton on Montrezl Harrell comments:

“I just want to know what he’s doing this year, what his resume is? It definitely adds a little fuel to the fire.”

Nic Claxton on Montrezl Harrell, Jan 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Rivers on Montrezl Harrell:

“Didn't do as well as he thought in Washington and then in Charlotte. We need him. He can be a big help for us ... we'll see. He's played well so far. We've just got to keep him on the right trails.”

Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell, Oct 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on playing Marc Gasol and Montrezl Harrell at the same time:

“It's tough to play two bigs in the modern NBA. Two centers.”

Frank Vogel on Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Dennis Schroder on Montrezl Harrell's $20k fine:

“We gonna take care of that. He had my back. We gonna take care of that for sure.”

Dennis Schroder on Montrezl Harrell, Apr 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“I don’t know what the numbers are on that, but I’d be willing (to think) that a lot of them are created from somebody drawing help and getting open shots. Just guys being open and shooting in rhythm — that’s part of what makes us a great team.“We have so many guys who get to that paint and draw attention and so many guys who complement and can stretch the floor. I’d say everybody but maybe (Montrezl Harrell) is stretching to (the) 3-point line — that plays minutes. At any given time, you’ve got four, five guys out there that can shoot 3s. That’s really hard to guard.”

Alex Caruso on Montrezl Harrell, Jan 22, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“When you have talented guys like LeBron and AD things on the offensive end are going to work themselves out. “You look at the guys we added: Schroder I think is a pit bull of a defender. Montrezl Harrell is one of the hardest-playing players in the NBA, just the way he brings it every night. I think Marc Gasol, [the 2013] defensive player of the year who is one of the highest-IQ players in today’s game, and then Wesley Matthews, who manages to stand out.”

Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell, Dec 5, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Kyle Goon:Rob Pelinka on Montrezl Harrell:

“He’s a terror and a beast to play against.... to get a chance to sign a player like him is just a privilege.”

Rob Pelinka on Montrezl Harrell, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: JJ Redick on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“Being called a b----a-- white boy was something I’ve heard when I was 12 or 13. I laughed when Montrezl said it. I thought it was hilarious.”

JJ Redick on Montrezl Harrell, Oct 3, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Andrew Greif:Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell:

“I feel like more than a coach watching Trez do this. I feel like a proud father.”

Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell, Sep 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Coach Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrel, the Clippers' latest Sixth Man of the Year winner:

“I'm just so proud of him, as a coach. He epitomizes what a Sixth Man of the Year award winner is. Trust me, we're getting used to them here.”

Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell, Sep 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell leaving the Orlando bubble to tend to a family emergency:

“Things happpen in our lives, so we just have to leave it there.”

Doc Rivers on Montrezl Harrell, Jul 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Patrick Patterson on Paul George, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Patrick Patterson:

“For us, we have guys that love to fish. I think it’s well known Paul George is a huge fisherman. Same thing with [Montrezl Harrell]. So they love to be out on the water, having access to boats. I think they have a couple of lakes here. Some guys enjoy playing spades, booray, card games, or whatever it may be. So being sure and having tables to provide for that. Some guys love old-school video games, arcade style, so they have an arcade here. Outdoor things, too—trails, bike trails, and courses to be able to go biking on.”

Patrick Patterson on Paul George, Montrezl Harrell, Jul 10, 2020. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Lou Williams on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Williams on Montrezl Harrell’s upcoming free agency:

“This is his opportunity to put himself in a great position financially... I really hope that we’re gonna be that opportunity for him.”

Lou Williams on Montrezl Harrell, Apr 18, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Louis Williams on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Lou Williams on if Montrezl Harrell doesn't come back to the Clippers next year:

“Obviously business is business, Trez has a family to take care of... I feel very confident that we'll be able to keep this group together.”

Louis Williams on Montrezl Harrell, Apr 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Steve Kerr on the visitors:

“The Clippers are very unique team; Harrell and Lou are probably their two best players -- how many teams bring their two best players off the bench? So we won’t get caught up in bench points ... (but) we’ll try to be better on them tonight.”

Steve Kerr on Montrezl Harrell, Apr 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“Montrezl is a tough, hard-playing, gritty competitor who is committed to winning,”

Lawrence Frank on Montrezl Harrell, Jul 24, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lee Seham on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
The NBRA released a statement concerning the floor altercation culminating in Rio Grande Valley player Montrezl Harrell forcefully shoving Referee Jason Goldenberg to the ground during a game with Bakersfield on March 26, 2016.

“After carefully reviewing videotape and related evidence concerning this incident, we have reached the inescapable conclusion that Harrell committed a deliberate assault and battery against Referee Goldenberg. Anything less than a multiple game suspension would constitute a green light for violence against officials,”

Lee Seham on Montrezl Harrell, Mar 29, 2016. Source: NBRA.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“I think our normal developmental program last year had Capela helping us with minutes at the end of the year. I think if we got Sam or Montrezl helping us at the end of the year, that will be fantastic.”

Daryl Morey on Montrezl Harrell, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Houston Chronicle.
